philosophy.p1: Achieving curriculum standards through focused attention and appropriate tools, empowering students to guide their own learning journey.

quotes.chairman: Our goal is to connect the dots to nurture minds, allowing every child to grow into a proud, confident adult.

admission.policiesTitle: Parent Declaration & Manhattan Private School Regulations
admission.policiesSubtitle: Please carefully review the following rules and financial policies before signing
policyPoints: I, the parent/guardian of the student, certify that the information written above is correct and under my responsibility, and I agree to register my son/daughter in the school.
I commit to all school instructions for this academic year, and this commitment is considered an integral part of this application.
I understand that discounts apply strictly to annual tuition fees only and do not cover transport, registration, books, or uniform.
In case of student withdrawal: fees paid after official school sessions set by the Ministry of Education are non-refundable, whereas unused term tuition and transport fees are refundable.
Tuition fees do not cover field trips or extra-curricular activities.
Tuition fees will not be reduced due to student absence for illness, travel, or any other reason.
I undertake to pay installments on time, and the school reserves the right to take necessary procedures in case of delay.
Note that the final school installment is due at the beginning of the year on September 1st of the academic year.
